description: Add one or more library-level domain referrers. Each entry has a hostname and a type (ALLOW|BLOCK, default ALLOW). The same hostname cannot coexist as both ALLOW and BLOCK at the library scope (duplicate check is type-agnostic). New rows start in 'pending' (when domain protection is active) or 'inactive'. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }.

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

hostname.description: Domain hostname without protocol, e.g. 'example.com' or wildcard '*.cliente.com'

type.description: ALLOW = whitelist (only listed domains play); BLOCK = blacklist (listed domains are denied)

name: panda_create_refer
title: Create Domain Referrers (library)
